import docx
from fpdf import FPDF

# Extract Maya Chen's section from the docx
doc = docx.Document("testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")
full_text = "\\n".join([p.text for p in doc.paragraphs])
lines = full_text.split("\\n")

maya_start = None
maya_end = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip() == "Maya Chen" and maya_start is None:
        maya_start = i
    elif maya_start is not None and not line.startswith("Order ORD-") and not line.startswith("  Items:") and not line.startswith("Email:") and line.strip() != "" and i > maya_start + 1:
        maya_end = i
        break
if maya_end is None:
    maya_end = len(lines)

maya_lines = lines[maya_start:maya_end]

# Build PDF
pdf = FPDF()
pdf.add_page()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)

# Title
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
pdf.cell(0, 12, "Customer Activity Report", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT", align="C")
pdf.ln(4)

# Customer name
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 14)
pdf.cell(0, 10, "Maya Chen", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")

# Email / Loyalty / Credit line
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
for line in maya_lines:
    if line.startswith("Email:"):
        pdf.cell(0, 7, line, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.ln(3)
        break

# Table header
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 9)
col_widths = [30, 22, 20, 18, 100]
headers = ["Order ID", "Date", "Status", "Total", "Items"]
for j, h in enumerate(headers):
    pdf.cell(col_widths[j], 8, h, border=1, align="C")
pdf.ln()

# Table rows
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 8)
current_order = None
for line in maya_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("Order ORD-"):
        # Parse: Order ORD-XXXX - DATE | Status: xxx | Total: $xx
        parts = line.replace("Order ", "").split(" | ")
        order_date = parts[0].split(" \\u2014 ")
        order_id = order_date[0].strip() if len(order_date) > 0 else ""
        date_val = order_date[1].strip() if len(order_date) > 1 else ""
        status = parts[1].replace("Status: ", "").strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        total = parts[2].replace("Total: ", "").strip() if len(parts) > 2 else ""
        current_order = {"id": order_id, "date": date_val, "status": status, "total": total, "items": ""}
    elif line.startswith("Items:") and current_order is not None:
        current_order["items"] = line.replace("Items: ", "").strip()
        # Write row
        o = current_order
        pdf.cell(col_widths[0], 7, o["id"], border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_widths[1], 7, o["date"], border=1, align="C")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[2], 7, o["status"], border=1, align="C")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[3], 7, o["total"], border=1, align="R")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[4], 7, o["items"], border=1)
        pdf.ln()
        current_order = None

pdf.output("output/maya_chen_activity_report.pdf")
print("PDF created: output/maya_chen_activity_report.pdf")
'''
